unit: Belfer Center for Science and International Affairs

labs.lab_name: Belfer Center for Science and International Affairs
labs.location: 79 John F. Kennedy Street, Cambridge, MA 02138
labs.research_summary: Harvard Kennedy School hub for research and training on international security and diplomacy, environment and resources, and science and technology policy.
labs.join_notes: Careers page says the Center hires for research and non-research roles and points to open opportunities and a student opportunities page for the Arctic Initiative. The fellowships page lists 14 fellowship tracks; applications for 2027-28 close December 1, 2026.
labs.notes: Natalie Colbert is Executive Director; leadership also lists a senior advisor and directors of communications, finance and operations. No general email shown on the pages read (a contact page is linked). The about page says over 150 resident scholars; the experts directory is paged, so no count recorded.

labs.lab_name: Program on Emerging Technology, Scientific Advancement, and Global Policy (ETSAGP)
labs.research_summary: Belfer program on emerging technology and global policy that hosts the Technology and Geopolitics and Nova fellowships.
labs.notes: Fellowships page says the program is under Director Meghan O'Sullivan and Program Director Michael McQuade. Listed on Belfer's fellowships page; not read further.

notes: Many other projects (Arctic Initiative, Managing the Atom, Middle East Initiative, International Security Program, Geopolitics of Energy and others) appear only as fellowship hosts with no lead or site on the pages read, so were not recorded as entries.
